United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)

title.narrative: The JPO will work under the overall leadership of the Director of the UNESCO IICBA and direct supervision of the Senior Programme Coordinator and in coordination with the colleagues from IICBA

description.narrative: Within this context, the JPO will be responsible for: • Assist in the implementation, monitoring and documentation of IICBA’s projects. • Assist in the development of evidence based analytical work on issues and challenges pertaining teacher education and development, particularly: The articulation between initial/in-service training and continuous professional development of teachers; Issues and challenges underpinning teacher education and teacher management. • Assist in the operationalization of a Teachers’ Motivation Framework for Africa, currently being developed by IICBA. • Assist in producing papers, reports, policy briefings informed by the findings on the conducted analytical work. • Contribute to deepening the understanding of teacher education institutions profile, including the tutors. • Contribute to needs assessment and identification of areas in need in teacher education and development. • Contribute to knowledge management and dissemination. • Perform any other activities and tasks that may be required to ensure the success of the IICBA work.
